newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MANGA-CHEM PLANS TO RAISE 5.5 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: MANGA-CHEM PLANS TO RAISE 5.5 MLN RAND.

text.p: South African mineral-based chemical products producer Manga-Chem Products Ltd said on Thursday it planned to raise up to 5.5 million rand through a clawback offer to shareholders.

The group said in a statement it would also issue unsecured compulsorily convertible debentures to Mineral Resources Corporation , an emerging Canadian mining house with interests in Canada, Vietnam, Australia, the U.S. and South Africa.
In terms of the deal, Toronto-listed Mineral Resources Corporation will acquire effective control of Manga-Chem and bring its mining management skills to bear on the South African operation.
The group said John Walls, currently chief executive officer of Australian Gold Development , in which Mineral Resources Corporation has an interest, would assume chairmanship of Manga-Chem.
"In terms of the arrangement, Manga-Chem shareholders will be made a clawback offer of 23.58 million ordinary shares at 6,5 cents a share," the group said.

Manga-Chem's name would be changed to reflect the change in control, and, subject to Johannesburg Stock Exchange approval, the listing would be switched from the Venture Capital Market sector to the main board.
